evals.prompt: Génère une image d'un phare breton au coucher du soleil, style photo argentique.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks the machine, picks an image tool and model, gets the estimate (exit 2) and asks the user before spending, then generates with --spend and gives the path and the real cost.
expectations: Runs `media.mjs doctor` before any other command of the skill
Runs the image command without --spend first and reads the estimate
Asks the user with AskUserQuestion, giving the price in USD and the model, before any --spend
Runs again with --spend set to the estimate only after the user's yes
Gives the output path and the cost printed by the command
Talks to the user in French

evals.prompt: Anime cette photo avec un dolly zoom sur le sujet : ../video-editor/engine/test/assets/photo.png
evals.expected_output: The video tool dolly-zoom-in with the photo as first frame, the estimate asked first, then the job run and waited for.
expectations: Finds the tool with `media.mjs tools video --search` (dolly)
Passes the photo as `--in first_frame=<path>`
Asks before spending, with the price in USD
Waits for the video job (background or long timeout) and reports the file

evals.prompt: Traduis cette vidéo en anglais et en espagnol : ../video-editor/engine/test/speech.mp4
evals.expected_output: The audio translate tool through ElevenLabs, the estimate in credits, the user's yes, and no lip-sync said.
expectations: Uses `audio --tool translate --in clip=<file> --field to=en,es`
Gives the price in ElevenLabs credits
Offers dubbing_v1 as the cheaper choice against dubbing_v2
Says there is no lip-sync
Never runs with --spend before the user's yes

evals.prompt:
media-generator — Copy prompt
Space: video · Tool: orbit (Orbit) · Model: openrouter:kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro
Fields: subject=a perfume bottle on black marble, direction=right, arc=a half turn
Inputs: first_frame=/tmp/bottle.png
What I want: a luxurious slow product reveal
Write the best prompt for this model, then run: media.mjs draft --space video --tool orbit --model openrouter:kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro --prompt "…" — do not generate.
evals.expected_output: A model-specific prompt written into the dashboard's draft, nothing generated and nothing spent.
expectations: Runs `media.mjs draft` with --space video, --tool orbit and the model
Never runs `media.mjs video` and never passes --spend
Tells the user to use the Reload bar in the dashboard

evals.prompt: Redessine cette photo en style laine tricotée : ../video-editor/engine/test/assets/photo.png
evals.expected_output: The image tool restyle with the photo as its image and the style Knitted yarn world, the estimate asked first.
expectations: Finds the tool with `media.mjs tools image --search` (restyle or style)
Passes the photo as `--in image=<path>` and `--field style=` Knitted yarn world (its label or value)
Asks before spending, with the price in USD
Never passes --spend before the user's yes

evals.prompt: Crée un style « encre » à partir de ces deux images, puis fais-moi un renard dans ce style : ../video-editor/engine/test/assets/a.png ../video-editor/engine/test/assets/b.png
evals.expected_output: A Library style made with `media.mjs styles add`, then a Custom image with `--field style=<its name>`, the estimate asked first.
expectations: Runs `media.mjs styles add <name> <images…>` (with --words when the user describes the look)
Generates with the image tool free and `--field style=<the style name>`
Asks before spending, with the price in USD

evals.prompt: Crée le personnage Lulu à partir de cette photo, je veux pouvoir le réutiliser dans mes prompts : ../video-editor/engine/test/assets/a.png
evals.expected_output: An Element of type character made with `media.mjs elements add Lulu <photo> --type character --words "…"` (words written after looking at the image), the @name given back; reference sheets only offered, never generated without a yes.
expectations: Runs `media.mjs elements add Lulu <the photo> --type character` with --words describing what it sees
Tells the user to cite it as @Lulu
Spends nothing without the user's yes (sheets are offered with their price, not made)

evals.prompt: Fais-moi une fiche personnage (vue de face, profil, dos et gros plan visage) d'une renarde en manteau vert, juste les images
evals.expected_output: The Character references tool (`image --tool character --field who="…"`), the default sheets Body turnaround and Face close-up, the estimate (their total) asked first; no Element made.
expectations: Uses `media.mjs image --tool character` with `--field who=…`
Keeps or names the sheets Body turnaround and Face close-up
Asks before spending, with the total price in USD
Does not run `elements add` (the user asked only for the images)
